FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Building Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates building definitions. Mostly for extensibility support.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates FCBuildingDefs: if a building A is listed as a requirement for building B, then both A and all upgrades of A will satisfy B's requirement
Block a building from being built if one of its upgrades already exists
